    "### 1.1 Continuous-Time vs. Discrete-Time Signals\n",
    "A continuous-time signal $x(t)$ is defined for all real $t$. A discrete-time signal $x[n]$ is defined only at integer indices $n$."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1000x500 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "# Continuous-time: 1000 points over [0, 1]\n",
    "t = np.linspace(0, 1, 1000)\n",
    "x_ct = np.cos(2 * np.pi * 5 * t)  # 5 Hz cosine\n",
    "\n",
    "# Discrete-time: 21 samples at fs = 20 Hz (n = 0, 1, ..., 20)\n",
    "fs = 20\n",
    "n = np.arange(0, 1 + 1/fs, 1/fs)\n",
    "x_dt = np.cos(2 * np.pi * 5 * n / fs)\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(10, 5), sharey=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "ax1.plot(t, x_ct, 'b-', linewidth=1)\n",
    "ax1.set_title(\"Continuous-Time: $x(t) = \\\\cos(2\\\\pi \\\\cdot 5 t)$\")\n",
    "ax1.set_xlabel(\"Time $t$ (s)\")\n",
    "ax1.set_ylabel(\"Amplitude\")\n",
    "ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n",
    "\n",
    "ax2.stem(n, x_dt, linefmt='r-', markerfmt='ro', basefmt='k-')\n",
    "ax2.set_title(\"Discrete-Time: $x[n] = \\\\cos(2\\\\pi \\\\cdot 5 \\\\cdot n / f_s)$, $f_s=20$ Hz\")\n",
    "ax2.set_xlabel(\"Sample index $n$\")\n",
    "ax2.set_ylabel(\"Amplitude\")\n",
    "ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]

   "source": [
    "### 1.2 Digital Signal: Quantization\n",
    "A digital signal is discrete in **both** time and amplitude. Quantization maps continuous amplitude values to a finite set of discrete levels."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1000x500 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Demonstrate quantization: round to nearest 0.25\n",
    "bits = 3\n",
    "levels = 2 ** bits\n",
    "q_step = 2 / levels  # signal range [-1, 1] -> 8 levels\n",
    "\n",
    "x_continuous = np.cos(2 * np.pi * 3 * t)\n",
    "x_quantized = np.round(x_continuous / q_step) * q_step\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(10, 5))\n",
    "\n",
    "ax1.plot(t[:200], x_continuous[:200], 'b-', linewidth=1, label=\"Continuous-valued\")\n",
    "ax1.set_title(\"Before Quantization (Continuous Amplitude)\")\n",
    "ax1.set_ylabel(\"Amplitude\")\n",
    "ax1.legend()\n",
    "ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n",
    "\n",
    "ax2.step(t[:200], x_quantized[:200], 'r-', linewidth=1, label=f\"Quantized ({bits}-bit, {levels} levels)\")\n",
    "for level in np.arange(-1, 1 + q_step, q_step):\n",
    "    ax2.axhline(level, color='gray', linestyle=':', alpha=0.3)\n",
    "ax2.set_title(f\"After Quantization (Discrete Amplitude, {bits}-bit)\")\n",
    "ax2.set_xlabel(\"Time $t$ (s)\")\n",
    "ax2.set_ylabel(\"Amplitude\")\n",
    "ax2.legend()\n",
    "ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },

      "Deterministic signal: exactly reproducible from formula.\n",
      "Random signal: mean=0.003, std=0.490 (statistical description)\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Deterministic signal: exact mathematical formula\n",
    "t = np.linspace(0, 2, 500)\n",
    "x_det = np.sin(2 * np.pi * 2 * t) + 0.5 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 5 * t)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Random signal: Gaussian white noise\n",
    "np.random.seed(42)\n",
    "x_rand = np.random.randn(500) * 0.5\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(10, 5))\n",
    "\n",
    "ax1.plot(t, x_det, 'b-', linewidth=1)\n",
    "ax1.set_title(\"Deterministic: $x(t) = \\\\sin(4\\\\pi t) + 0.5\\\\sin(10\\\\pi t)$\")\n",
    "ax1.set_ylabel(\"Amplitude\")\n",
    "ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n",
    "\n",
    "ax2.plot(t, x_rand, 'r-', linewidth=0.8)\n",
    "ax2.set_title(\"Random: Gaussian White Noise ($\\\\sigma=0.5$)\")\n",
    "ax2.set_xlabel(\"Time $t$ (s)\")\n",
    "ax2.set_ylabel(\"Amplitude\")\n",
    "ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Deterministic signal: exactly reproducible from formula.\")\n",
    "print(f\"Random signal: mean={x_rand.mean():.3f}, std={x_rand.std():.3f} (statistical description)\")"
   ]

    "### 2.1 Complex Exponential & Phasor Visualization\n",
    "Euler's identity: $e^{j\\\\phi} = \\\\cos\\\\phi + j\\\\sin\\\\phi$. A rotating phasor in the complex plane projects onto the real axis as a sinusoid."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/html": [
       "\n",
       "<link rel=\"stylesheet\"\n",
       "href=\"https://maxcdn.bootstrapcdn.com/font-awesome/4.4.0/css/font-awesome.min.css\">\n",
       "<script language=\"javascript\">\n",
       "  function isInternetExplorer() {\n",
       "    ua = navigator.userAgent;\n",
       "    /* MSIE used to detect old browsers and Trident used to newer ones*/\n",
       "    return ua.indexOf(\"MSIE \") > -1 || ua.indexOf(\"Trident/\") > -1;\n",
       "  }\n",
       "\n",
       "  /* Define the Animation class */\n",
       "  function Animation(frames, img_id, slider_id, interval, loop_select_id){\n",
       "    this.img_id = img_id;\n",
       "    this.slider_id = slider_id;\n",
       "    this.loop_select_id = loop_select_id;\n",
       "    this.interval = interval;\n",
       "    this.current_frame = 0;\n",
       "    this.direction = 0;\n",
       "    this.timer = null;\n",
       "    this.frames = new Array(frames.length);\n",
       "\n",
       "    for (var i=0; i<frames.length; i++)\n",
       "    {\n",
       "     this.frames[i] = new Image();\n",
       "     this.frames[i].src = frames[i];\n",
       "    }\n",
       "    var slider = document.getElementById(this.slider_id);\n",
       "    slider.max = this.frames.length - 1;\n",
       "    if (isInternetExplorer()) {\n",
       "        // switch from oninput to onchange because IE <= 11 does not conform\n",
       "        // with W3C specification. It ignores oninput and onchange behaves\n",
       "        // like oninput. In contrast, Microsoft Edge behaves correctly.\n",
       "        slider.setAttribute('onchange', slider.getAttribute('oninput'));\n",
       "        slider.setAttribute('oninput', null);\n",
       "    }\n",
       "    this.set_frame(this.current_frame);\n",
       "  }\n",
       "\n",
       "  Animation.prototype.get_loop_state = function(){\n",
       "    var button_group = document[this.loop_select_id].state;\n",
       "    for (var i = 0; i < button_group.length; i++) {\n",
       "        var button = button_group[i];\n",
       "        if (button.checked) {\n",
       "            return button.value;\n",
       "        }\n",
       "    }\n",
       "    return undefined;\n",
       "  }\n",
       "\n",
       "  Animation.prototype.set_frame = function(frame){\n",
       "    this.current_frame = frame;\n",
       "    document.getElementById(this.img_id).src =\n",
       "            this.frames[this.current_frame].src;\n",
       "    document.getElementById(this.slider_id).value = this.current_frame;\n",
       "  }\n",
       "\n",
       "  Animation.prototype.next_frame = function()\n",
       "  {\n",
       "    this.set_frame(Math.min(this.frames.length - 1, this.current_frame + 1));\n",
       "  }\n",
       "\n",
       "  Animation.prototype.previous_frame = function()\n",
       "  {\n",
       "    this.set_frame(Math.max(0, this.current_frame - 1));\n",
       "  }\n",
       "\n",
       "  Animation.prototype.first_frame = function()\n",
       "  {\n",
       "    this.set_frame(0);\n",
       "  }\n",
       "\n",
       "  Animation.prototype.last_frame = function()\n",
       "  {\n",
       "    this.set_frame(this.frames.length - 1);\n",
       "  }\n",
       "\n",
       "  Animation.prototype.slower = function()\n",
       "  {\n",
       "    this.interval /= 0.7;\n",
       "    if(this.direction > 0){this.play_animation();}\n",
       "    else if(this.direction < 0){this.reverse_animation();}\n",
       "  }\n",
       "\n",
       "  Animation.prototype.faster = function()\n",
       "  {\n",
       "    this.interval *= 0.7;\n",
       "    if(this.direction > 0){this.play_animation();}\n",
       "    else if(this.direction < 0){this.reverse_animation();}\n",
       "  }\n",
       "\n",
       "  Animation.prototype.anim_step_forward = function()\n",
       "  {\n",
       "    this.current_frame += 1;\n",
       "    if(this.current_frame < this.frames.length){\n",
       "      this.set_frame(this.current_frame);\n",
       "    }else{\n",
       "      var loop_state = this.get_loop_state();\n",
       "      if(loop_state == \"loop\"){\n",
       "        this.first_frame();\n",
       "      }else if(loop_state == \"reflect\"){\n",
       "        this.last_frame();\n",
       "        this.reverse_animation();\n",
       "      }else{\n",
       "        this.pause_animation();\n",
       "        this.last_frame();\n",
       "      }\n",
       "    }\n",
       "  }\n",
       "\n",
       "  Animation.prototype.anim_step_reverse = function()\n",
       "  {\n",
       "    this.current_frame -= 1;\n",
       "    if(this.current_frame >= 0){\n",
       "      this.set_frame(this.current_frame);\n",
       "    }else{\n",
       "      var loop_state = this.get_loop_state();\n",
       "      if(loop_state == \"loop\"){\n",
       "        this.last_frame();\n",
       "      }else if(loop_state == \"reflect\"){\n",
       "        this.first_frame();\n",
       "        this.play_animation();\n",
       "      }else{\n",
       "        this.pause_animation();\n",
       "        this.first_frame();\n",
       "      }\n",
       "    }\n",
       "  }\n",
       "\n",
       "  Animation.prototype.pause_animation = function()\n",
       "  {\n",
       "    this.direction = 0;\n",
       "    if (this.timer){\n",
       "      clearInterval(this.timer);\n",
       "      this.timer = null;\n",
       "    }\n",
       "  }\n",
       "\n",
       "  Animation.prototype.play_animation = function()\n",
       "  {\n",
       "    this.pause_animation();\n",
       "    this.direction = 1;\n",
       "    var t = this;\n",
       "    if (!this.timer) this.timer = setInterval(function() {\n",
       "        t.anim_step_forward();\n",
       "    }, this.interval);\n",
       "  }\n",
       "\n",
       "  Animation.prototype.reverse_animation = function()\n",
       "  {\n",
       "    this.pause_animation();\n",
       "    this.direction = -1;\n",
       "    var t = this;\n",
       "    if (!this.timer) this.timer = setInterval(function() {\n",
       "        t.anim_step_reverse();\n",
       "    }, this.interval);\n",
       "  }\n",
       "</script>\n",

    "# Animate a rotating phasor and its real projection\n",
    "from matplotlib.animation import FuncAnimation\n",
    "from IPython.display import HTML\n",
    "\n",
    "omega = 2 * np.pi * 1  # 1 Hz\n",
    "t_vals = np.linspace(0, 2, 200)\n",
    "phasor = np.exp(1j * omega * t_vals)  # complex exponential\n",
    "real_part = np.real(phasor)\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4.5))\n",
    "\n",
    "# Complex plane\n",
    "ax1.set_xlim(-1.5, 1.5)\n",
    "ax1.set_ylim(-1.5, 1.5)\n",
    "ax1.set_aspect('equal')\n",
    "ax1.axhline(y=0, color='k', linewidth=0.5)\n",
    "ax1.axvline(x=0, color='k', linewidth=0.5)\n",
    "ax1.set_xlabel(\"Re\")\n",
    "ax1.set_ylabel(\"Im\")\n",
    "ax1.set_title(\"Complex Plane (Phasor)\")\n",
    "circle = plt.Circle((0, 0), 1, fill=False, color='gray', linestyle='--')\n",
    "ax1.add_patch(circle)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Time domain\n",
    "ax2.set_xlim(0, 2)\n",
    "ax2.set_ylim(-1.5, 1.5)\n",
    "ax2.axhline(y=0, color='k', linewidth=0.5)\n",
    "ax2.set_xlabel(\"Time $t$ (s)\")\n",
    "ax2.set_ylabel(\"Amplitude\")\n",
    "ax2.set_title(\"Time Domain (Real Projection)\")\n",
    "\n",
    "phasor_line, = ax1.plot([], [], 'b-', linewidth=2)\n",
    "phasor_head, = ax1.plot([], [], 'bo', markersize=6)\n",
    "proj_line, = ax1.plot([], [], 'r--', linewidth=1, alpha=0.7)\n",
    "proj_dot, = ax1.plot([], [], 'ro', markersize=4)\n",
    "\n",
    "time_line, = ax2.plot([], [], 'b-', linewidth=1)\n",
    "time_dot, = ax2.plot([], [], 'ro', markersize=6)\n",
    "\n",
    "def update(frame):\n",
    "    i = frame\n",
    "    phasor_line.set_data([0, np.real(phasor[i])], [0, np.imag(phasor[i])])\n",
    "    phasor_head.set_data([np.real(phasor[i])], [np.imag(phasor[i])])\n",
    "    proj_line.set_data([np.real(phasor[i]), np.real(phasor[i])], [0, np.imag(phasor[i])])\n",
    "    proj_dot.set_data([np.real(phasor[i])], [0])\n",
    "    time_line.set_data(t_vals[:i+1], real_part[:i+1])\n",
    "    time_dot.set_data([t_vals[i]], [real_part[i]])\n",
    "    return phasor_line, phasor_head, proj_line, proj_dot, time_line, time_dot\n",
    "\n",
    "ani = FuncAnimation(fig, update, frames=len(t_vals), interval=30, blit=True)\n",
    "plt.close()\n",
    "HTML(ani.to_jshtml())"

    "### 2.2 Discrete-Time Sinusoid Periodicity\n",
    "A discrete sinusoid $x[n] = \\\\cos(\\\\omega n)$ is periodic **only if** $f = \\\\omega/(2\\\\pi)$ is a rational number: $f = k/N$."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {},

     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1000x700 with 3 Axes>"

     "output_type": "display_data"

   "source": [
    "def check_periodicity(omega, N_check=100):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Check if cos(omega * n) is periodic and find its period.\"\"\"\n",
    "    f = omega / (2 * np.pi)\n",
    "    n = np.arange(N_check)\n",
    "    x = np.cos(omega * n)\n",
    "    return f, x\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(10, 7))\n",
    "\n",
    "# Case 1: Periodic - rational frequency f = 1/8\n",
    "omega1 = 2 * np.pi * 1/8\n",
    "f1, x1 = check_periodicity(omega1, 40)\n",
    "axes[0].stem(np.arange(40), x1, linefmt='b-', markerfmt='bo', basefmt='k-')\n",
    "axes[0].set_title(f\"$\\\\omega = 2\\\\pi \\\\cdot 1/8$, $f = {1/8}$ (rational) → Periodic, $N=8$\")\n",
    "axes[0].set_ylabel(\"$x[n]$\")\n",
    "axes[0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n",
    "# Highlight one period\n",
    "for k in range(0, 40, 8):\n",
    "    axes[0].axvspan(k, k+8, alpha=0.1, color='blue')\n",
    "\n",
    "# Case 2: Aperiodic - irrational frequency f = 1/(2π)\n",
    "omega2 = 1.0  # f = 1/(2π), irrational\n",
    "f2, x2 = check_periodicity(omega2, 40)\n",
    "axes[1].stem(np.arange(40), x2, linefmt='r-', markerfmt='ro', basefmt='k-')\n",
    "axes[1].set_title(f\"$\\\\omega = 1$, $f = 1/(2\\\\pi) \\\\approx {1/(2*np.pi):.4f}$ (irrational) → Aperiodic\")\n",
    "axes[1].set_ylabel(\"$x[n]$\")\n",
    "axes[1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Case 3: Periodic - rational frequency f = 3/8\n",
    "omega3 = 2 * np.pi * 3/8\n",
    "f3, x3 = check_periodicity(omega3, 40)\n",
    "axes[2].stem(np.arange(40), x3, linefmt='g-', markerfmt='go', basefmt='k-')\n",
    "axes[2].set_title(f\"$\\\\omega = 2\\\\pi \\\\cdot 3/8$, $f = {3/8}$ (rational) → Periodic, $N=8$\")\n",
    "axes[2].set_xlabel(\"Sample index $n$\")\n",
    "axes[2].set_ylabel(\"$x[n]$\")\n",
    "axes[2].grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n",
    "for k in range(0, 40, 8):\n",
    "    axes[2].axvspan(k, k+8, alpha=0.1, color='green')\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]

    "### 2.6 System Properties: Linearity Test\n",
    "Superposition: $\\\\mathcal{T}[a x_1[n] + b x_2[n]] = a\\\\mathcal{T}[x_1[n]] + b\\\\mathcal{T}[x_2[n]]$."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Linear: $y[n]=3x[n]$:\n",
      "  LHS = T[a·x1 + b·x2], RHS = a·T[x1] + b·T[x2]\n",
      "  Match: True\n",
      "  Max |LHS - RHS| = 8.88e-16\n",
      "\n",
      "Nonlinear: $y[n]=x^2[n]$:\n",
      "  LHS = T[a·x1 + b·x2], RHS = a·T[x1] + b·T[x2]\n",
      "  Match: False\n",
      "  Max |LHS - RHS| = 7.24e+00\n",
      "\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Test two systems for linearity\n",
    "n = np.arange(0, 20)\n",
    "x1 = np.sin(2 * np.pi * 0.1 * n)   # input 1\n",
    "x2 = np.cos(2 * np.pi * 0.15 * n)  # input 2\n",
    "a, b = 2, -1  # arbitrary constants\n",
    "\n",
    "def system_linear(x):\n",
    "    \"\"\"y[n] = 3*x[n] (scaling, linear)\"\"\"\n",
    "    return 3 * x\n",
    "\n",
    "def system_nonlinear(x):\n",
    "    \"\"\"y[n] = x[n]^2 (nonlinear)\"\"\"\n",
    "    return x ** 2\n",
    "\n",
    "for name, system in [(\"Linear: $y[n]=3x[n]$\", system_linear),\n",
    "                       (\"Nonlinear: $y[n]=x^2[n]$\", system_nonlinear)]:\n",
    "    lhs = system(a * x1 + b * x2)\n",
    "    rhs = a * system(x1) + b * system(x2)\n",
    "    is_linear = np.allclose(lhs, rhs)\n",
    "    print(f\"{name}:\")\n",
    "    print(f\"  LHS = T[a·x1 + b·x2], RHS = a·T[x1] + b·T[x2]\")\n",
    "    print(f\"  Match: {is_linear}\")\n",
    "    print(f\"  Max |LHS - RHS| = {np.max(np.abs(lhs - rhs)):.2e}\")\n",
    "    print()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### 2.7 System Properties: Time-Invariance Test\n",
    "$\\\\mathcal{T}[x[n-k]] = y[n-k]$ — a delay in input produces the same delay in output."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "TI: $y[n]=x[n]-x[n-1]$:\n",
      "  LHS = T[x[n-3]], RHS = y[n-3]\n",
      "  Match (after shift): True\n",
      "\n",
      "TV: $y[n]=n \\cdot x[n]$:\n",
      "  LHS = T[x[n-3]], RHS = y[n-3]\n",
      "  Match (after shift): False\n",
      "\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "k = 3  # shift amount\n",
    "n = np.arange(0, 20)\n",
    "\n",
    "def system_ti(x):\n",
    "    \"\"\"y[n] = x[n] - x[n-1] (differencer, time-invariant)\"\"\"\n",
    "    y = np.zeros_like(x)\n",
    "    y[1:] = x[1:] - x[:-1]\n",
    "    y[0] = x[0]\n",
    "    return y\n",
    "\n",
    "def system_tv(x):\n",
    "    \"\"\"y[n] = n * x[n] (amplitude modulation, time-variant)\"\"\"\n",
    "    return np.arange(len(x)) * x\n",
    "\n",
    "x = np.sin(2 * np.pi * 0.1 * np.arange(0, 25))\n",
    "\n",
    "for name, system in [(\"TI: $y[n]=x[n]-x[n-1]$\", system_ti),\n",
    "                       (\"TV: $y[n]=n \\\\cdot x[n]$\", system_tv)]:\n",
    "    # LHS: shift then apply system\n",
    "    x_shifted = np.roll(x, k)\n",
    "    x_shifted[:k] = 0  # zero-pad for causal shift\n",
    "    lhs = system(x_shifted)\n",
    "    \n",
    "    # RHS: apply system then shift\n",
    "    y = system(x)\n",
    "    rhs = np.roll(y, k)\n",
    "    rhs[:k] = 0\n",
    "    \n",
    "    is_ti = np.allclose(lhs[k:], rhs[k:])\n",
    "    print(f\"{name}:\")\n",
    "    print(f\"  LHS = T[x[n-{k}]], RHS = y[n-{k}]\")\n",
    "    print(f\"  Match (after shift): {is_ti}\")\n",
    "    print()"
   ]
  },

   "cell_type": "markdown",

    "### 2.8 Causality and BIBO Stability"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 11,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1000x600 with 3 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "--- BIBO Stability ---\n"
     ]
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1000x400 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    },
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "The accumulator is BIBO UNSTABLE: bounded input u[n] produces unbounded output (grows without limit).\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# Causal vs Non-causal system\n",
    "n = np.arange(-5, 11)\n",
    "x = np.where((n >= 0) & (n <= 5), n, 0)  # ramp from 0 to 5\n",
    "\n",
    "def system_causal(x):\n",
    "    \"\"\"y[n] = x[n] + x[n-1] (causal: depends on present & past)\"\"\"\n",
    "    y = np.zeros_like(x)\n",
    "    y[1:] = x[1:] + x[:-1]\n",
    "    y[0] = x[0]\n",
    "    return y\n",
    "\n",
    "def system_noncausal(x):\n",
    "    \"\"\"y[n] = x[n+1] (non-causal: depends on future)\"\"\"\n",
    "    y = np.zeros_like(x)\n",
    "    y[:-1] = x[1:]\n",
    "    return y\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(10, 6))\n",
    "\n",
    "axes[0].stem(n, x, linefmt='k-', markerfmt='ko', basefmt='k-')\n",
    "axes[0].set_title(\"Input $x[n]$ (ramp)\")\n",
    "axes[0].set_ylabel(\"$x[n]$\")\n",
    "axes[0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n",
    "\n",
    "y_causal = system_causal(x)\n",
    "axes[1].stem(n, y_causal, linefmt='b-', markerfmt='bo', basefmt='k-')\n",
    "axes[1].set_title(\"Causal Output: $y[n] = x[n] + x[n-1]$\")\n",
    "axes[1].set_ylabel(\"$y[n]$\")\n",
    "axes[1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n",
    "\n",
    "y_noncausal = system_noncausal(x)\n",
    "axes[2].stem(n, y_noncausal, linefmt='r-', markerfmt='ro', basefmt='k-')\n",
    "axes[2].set_title(\"Non-Causal Output: $y[n] = x[n+1]$ (peaks early!)\")\n",
    "axes[2].set_xlabel(\"Sample index $n$\")\n",
    "axes[2].set_ylabel(\"$y[n]$\")\n",
    "axes[2].grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "# BIBO stability: accumulator example\n",
    "print(\"--- BIBO Stability ---\")\n",
    "n_acc = np.arange(0, 20)\n",
    "x_bounded = np.ones(20)  # bounded input: |x[n]| ≤ 1\n",
    "y_accumulator = np.cumsum(x_bounded)  # accumulator output\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(10, 4))\n",
    "ax1.stem(n_acc, x_bounded, linefmt='k-', markerfmt='ko', basefmt='k-')\n",
    "ax1.set_title(\"Bounded Input: $x[n] = u[n]$, $|x[n]| \\\\leq 1$\")\n",
    "ax1.set_ylim(0, 2)\n",
    "ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n",
    "\n",
    "ax2.stem(n_acc, y_accumulator, linefmt='r-', markerfmt='ro', basefmt='k-')\n",
    "ax2.set_title(\"Accumulator Output: $y[n] = \\\\sum_{k=0}^{n} x[k] = n+1$ → Unbounded!\")\n",
    "ax2.set_xlabel(\"Sample index $n$\")\n",
    "ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n",
    "print(\"The accumulator is BIBO UNSTABLE: bounded input u[n] produces unbounded output (grows without limit).\")"
   ]
  },
